inputs.commit_message: Inspect active local runner process tree
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== relevant process tree ==='
ps -eo pid,ppid,etimes,stat,cmd --sort=etimes | grep -E 'local-agent-main-apply|release-commands|android:r8|gradle|java|tsx|npm|node' | grep -v grep | tail -n 160
echo '=== main worktree status ==='
git -C /home/hesham/gova/.local/agent-worktrees/__main status --short --untracked-files=no || true
echo '=== build job files in active worktree ==='
find /home/hesham/gova/.local/agent-worktrees/__main/.backups/build-jobs -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %s bytes\n' 2>/dev/null | tail -n 40 || true
